title: Buffer: The Unfair Advantage
coreMove: Build margin before reality interrupts, so surprise does not turn essential work into emergency response.
sourcePressure: The chapter begins execution by treating the unexpected as predictable enough to plan for through buffers, scenario planning, larger estimates, and resilience.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would say leave extra time as a scheduling tip without teaching the planning fallacy or contingency logic.
